intervals.quote: I will discuss the status of the proposed SABRE experiment, which will be comprised of a pair of high purity 50-60 kg NaI crystal detectors with active veto shielding to be located in labs in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres respectively.

intervals.label: installation and assembly of SABRE South in SUPL
intervals.note: Installation began in early 2024 (the muon veto was commissioned in 'telescope mode' then). Assembly of the full detector slipped repeatedly: 'commissioning ... expected to occur in 2023' (arXiv:2211.03016), 'ready to take data ... by 2025' (arXiv:2205.13849), 'full commissioning ... planned for the first quarter of 2026' (TIPP 2026 abstract), 'assembly ... will take place this year' (COSMO-26 abstract, August 2026). The March 2026 muon paper still calls it 'the upcoming SABRE South experiment'.
intervals.quote: The construction of SUPL was completed in 2023, with the first access for SABRE South installation activities in early 2024.

summary.plain: SABRE South is the Australian half of a twin pair of sodium-iodide dark matter detectors, being assembled 1 km underground in the Stawell gold mine, Victoria. Being in the Southern Hemisphere helps tell a real dark matter signal from seasonal effects, when tested against DAMA/LIBRA's yearly signal. Its twin, SABRE North, is in Italy.
summary.technical: Seven ultra-high-purity NaI(Tl) crystals (35 kg or 50 kg in all) in oxygen-free copper enclosures, with Hamamatsu R11065 photomultipliers at both ends, suspended in an 11.6 kL linear alkylbenzene liquid-scintillator veto (at least 18 R5912 photomultipliers) inside steel and polyethylene shielding, with a muon veto of eight EJ-200 plastic scintillator panels. Expected background 0.72 cpd/kg/keV in 1-6 keV; 5 sigma discovery or 3 sigma exclusion of a DAMA/LIBRA-like modulation after two years. Muon flux at SUPL measured at (6.33 +- 0.04 +- 0.35) x 10^-8 cm^-2 s^-1 with the veto panels (2026).

technology.quote: Ultra-high purity NaI(Tl) crystals are immersed in a linear alkyl benzene (LAB) based liquid scintillator veto, further surrounded by passive steel and polyethylene shielding and a plastic scintillator muon veto.
technology.value: Ultra-high-purity NaI(Tl) crystals read by photomultipliers inside a linear-alkylbenzene liquid-scintillator veto and a plastic-scintillator muon veto
